title: 5-Day Lang Co Bay Secluded Links & Banyan Tree Sanctuary
description: Secluded luxury pool villa golf retreat at Banyan Tree Lang Co. Play Sir Nick Faldo’s oceanfront gem and Luke Donald’s Ba Na Hills.

signatureTour.title: The Central Coast Classic
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our comprehensive 7-day Central Coast Classic combining Lang Co Bay with Hoi An and Da Nang championship courses.

inclusions.detail: Door-to-door private luxury chauffeured transfer for all airport and golf rounds.
3 rounds: 2 rounds at Laguna Golf Lang Co (Sir Nick Faldo) and 1 round at Ba Na Hills Golf Club.
4 nights in a Lagoon Pool Villa at Banyan Tree Lang Co.
Signature holistic massage treatment to relieve golfing fatigue.
Personal caddie pairing and guaranteed morning tee times.

itinerary.title: Arrival via Hai Van Coast & Secluded Pool Villa Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Coastal Sanctuary Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Banyan Tree Lang Co — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Banyan Tree Lang Co luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Da Nang International Airport and travel north through the spectacular Hai Van coastal pass to Banyan Tree Lang Co, nestled between the Truong Son mountains and a tranquil crescent bay. Check in to your Lagoon Pool Villa featuring traditional Vietnamese architectural aesthetics and a private plunge pool.

Unwind with a welcome herbal cocktail on your villa sun deck before dining at Saffron, the resort's signature cliffside Thai restaurant offering dramatic views of the East Sea.

itinerary.title: Championship Links Strategy at Laguna Golf Lang Co
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Sir Nick Faldo Coastal Gem
itinerary.imageCaption: Laguna Golf Lang Co — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 71, 6,891 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Laguna Golf Lang Co championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off right on your doorstep at Laguna Golf Lang Co. Sir Nick Faldo’s 7,100-yard par-71 layout weaves through active rice paddies, coastal pine groves, and rugged ocean blowouts. The signature par-3 5th hole requires a nerveless strike between giant boulders to a green set against the breaking waves.

Following play, return to Banyan Tree for an afternoon 60-minute therapeutic massage at the world-renowned Banyan Tree Spa, decompressing your shoulders and spine.

itinerary.title: Mountain Jungle Drama at Ba Na Hills Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Mountain Parkland Challenge
itinerary.imageCaption: Ba Na Hills Golf Club — Luke Donald / IMG (Par 72, 7,858 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Ba Na Hills Golf Club championship golf course Luke Donald / IMG Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel inland to Ba Na Hills Golf Club. Luke Donald’s layout winds through virgin mountain terrain with dramatic elevation drops, requiring precision clubbing into well-defended Paspalum greens.

Enjoy lunch overlooking the mountain valley before returning to Lang Co for a peaceful sunset walk along the 3-kilometer private sand beach.

itinerary.title: Mastering Faldo’s Contours: Laguna Lang Co Replay Round
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Championship Replay
itinerary.imageCaption: Laguna Golf Lang Co — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 71, 6,891 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Laguna Golf Lang Co championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Return to Laguna Golf Lang Co for a strategic replay round, using your newfound knowledge of Faldo's subtle slopes, bunker placement, and coastal cross-winds to improve your tournament score.

Spend your final evening enjoying a private beach barbecue dinner served right outside your pool villa with the sound of the ocean waves.

itinerary.title: Private Executive Departure to Da Nang Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Banyan Tree Lang Co — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Banyan Tree Lang Co luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast on your villa deck before checking out with the assistance of your AGS concierge.

Your private executive transfer delivers you back to Da Nang International Airport in comfort for your return flight home.

faqs.question: Is Laguna Golf Lang Co walkable?
faqs.answer: While buggies are provided, the course is enjoyable to walk during the cooler winter months between November and February.
